A one-shot comic focusing on Caius Ballad and Yeul from Final Fantasy XIII-2.

Both a Prologue and an Epilogue to the Final Fantasy XIII trilogy, giving a canon-friendly definitive conclusion to the pivotal characters that are not named Lighting Farron only.
